model_system: spin-1/2 nearest-neighbor XXZ Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the kagome lattice with added scalar-chirality, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya, and/or bowtie ring-exchange perturbations

key_params.perturbations: triangle chirality term; Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya term; bowtie ring-exchange term
key_params.mapping: flux-attachment of hard-core bosons/spins to fermions coupled to a lattice Chern-Simons gauge field
key_params.field_condition: main zero-field claim; additional plateaus discussed with external magnetic field

headline_claim: In the XY regime, the chirality term drives a zero-field chiral spin liquid with effective spin Hall conductance sigma_xy^s = 1/2 (dimensionless, in the paper's units).
replication_difficulty: high - requires reconstructing a lattice flux-attachment/Chern-Simons mean-field treatment on kagome with nonstandard formalism and approximations not tied to a small parameter.
